meaning:
κατα-στρέφω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., Gen.19:21, Jer.20:16, al. ;]
1. to turn down, turn over; as, the soil.
2. to overturn, overthrow: Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15; pass. pf. ptcp., Act.15:16 (LXX).†
(AS)
